subject.title: feat(ui): Model Providers settings page with auth, quota, and cost per provider

question: Should provider auth, quota, billing, and local spend become a dedicated Settings page rather than remain in the existing Usage, chat quota, and CLI surfaces?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible, but it adds a new top-level Settings destination and the canonical issue is explicitly marked as needing a product decision.

options.title: Approve dedicated page
options.body: Keep this information architecture and require conflict resolution plus real-gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Consolidate existing surfaces
options.body: Keep provider analytics in Usage and add narrower auth or discoverability improvements to existing pages.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader Control UI Settings structure is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated page
recommendation.body: Keep this information architecture and require conflict resolution plus real-gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He proposed this product direction and owns the strongest merged history in the provider-usage infrastructure it surfaces.
